description: TY2026: SS 6655(e) installment 3 with the recapture cap binding. Installments 1-2 were 21,000 each (annualized 3-month income). Six-month TI 350,000 x2 = 700,000 -> 21% = 147,000 -> 75% = 110,250 minus 42,000 prior = 68,250 — but the telescoped cap (3 x 31,500 - 42,000 = 52,500) binds -> $52,500.00.
